rules: Accept GameData/LOCALIZATION-CONTRACT.md: strings schemaVersion stays 1, en added; stages/ads remain unchanged. formatArgCount in this request is authoring metadata only; JSON need not emit it.
ko/en required. Preserve existing key/ko rows. Conflicting revised UI copy uses client_ prefixed new keys; all 30 stage titles need en.
Accept simple contiguous {0}/{1} and escaped {{/}} per data contract. Same indices in both languages; no alignment/specifiers.
Locale codes ko/en. First-run default ko; missing/unknown saved locale falls back ko. User language names remain native in either locale.
Legal original body, Unity development overlay and diagnostic logs are not translated. All game UI labels use keys.
WebGL loading/error strings should also be generated from this table at build time.
